simple.meaning: רָבַב (râbab) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to shoot an arrow.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Genesis, Psalms, beginning at Genesis 49:23. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָבַב (H7232) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: רָבַב (râbab) / H7232 is traced through Genesis 49:23, Psalms 18:15 with source-language evidence and verse context.
